description: This Java class implements the OrderSetDAO interface using Hibernate for database operations related to OrderSet entities within the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and deleting OrderSet and related entity objects, with specific focus on Hibernate session management and criteria queries. The class is used as a data access layer component injected into higher-level services.

classes.name: HibernateOrderSetDAO
classes.description: Implementation of OrderSetDAO using Hibernate ORM for database interactions, managing OrderSet entities and related types.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persist or update an OrderSet entity in the database using Hibernate session.

methods.name: getOrderSets
methods.description: Retrieve a list of OrderSet objects, optionally including retired ones based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: getOrderSetById
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderSet by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetByUniqueUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderSet by its unique UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderSetMember by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllOrderSetAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieve all OrderSetAttributeType objects from the database.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderSetAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Save or update an OrderSetAttributeType entity.

methods.name: deleteOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Delete an OrderSetAttributeType entity from the database.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderSetAttribute by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderSetAttributeType by its name.
